steps.code:
# We'll search for each song to get its release date. We'll use the search_songs API.
# We'll define the list of songs that need release dates (from the note content).
songs_to_fill = [
    ("Tangled Lies", "Ava Morgan"),
    ("Lost in the Wilderness of Love", "Lily Moon, Zoey James"),
    ("Whispers of a Forgotten Love", "Lily Moon, Zoey James"),
    ("Lost in the Twilight of Hope", "Felix Blackwood"),
    ("The Distance Between Two Hearts", "Jasper Skye"),
    ("When All Hope Seems Lost", "Seraphina Dawn"),
    ("The Forgotten Pages of Time", "Luna Starlight"),
    ("Summer's End", "Ethan Wallace"),
    ("A Tale of Unspoken Longing", "Emily Rivers"),
    ("Cracks in the Facade of Love", "Velvet Echo"),
    ("A Fading Reflection in Water", "Lucas Grey"),
    ("Trapped in a Daydream", "Nova Harmony"),
    ("Mystic Voyage to Avalon", "Nova Harmony"),
]

# We'll store results in a dict: song_title -> release_month (MM/YYYY)
release_months = {}

for title, artist in songs_to_fill:
    query = f"{title} {artist}"
    print(f"Searching: {query}")
    result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, page_limit=20)
    # Find the first result that matches title and artist exactly
    found = None
    for song in result.get('songs', []):
        # Check if song title and artist match (case-insensitive)
        if song.get('title','').lower() == title.lower() and song.get('artist','').lower() == artist.lower():
            found = song
            break
    if found:
        release_date = found.get('release_date')
        # Convert to MM/YYYY
        # release_date format is like "2022-12-11T06:22:44"
        month = release_date[5:7]
        year = release_date[0:4]
        release_months[title] = f"{month}/{year}"
        print(f"  Found: {title} by {artist} -> {release_months[title]}")
    else:
        print(f"  WARNING: No exact match found for {title} by {artist}")
        # Print first few results for debugging
        for song in result.get('songs', [])[:3]:
            print(f"    Candidate: {song.get('title')} by {song.get('artist')} (id={song.get('song_id')})")

print("\nAll release months collected:")
for title, month in release_months.items():
    print(f"{title}: {month}")
